class.description: R0192 Operator-Panel: Buttons für Homing (/homing) und Motoren EIN/AUS (/robot_enable), plus Status-Anzeige.
R0192 control panel: teach-pendant jogging (6x -/+ buttons, 3 modes via MoveIt Servo, speed slider, live readout) plus operator controls (Homing, Servo enable, MoveIt goal-marker visibility toggle).
R0192 program run panel (runtime-only, no editor): load YAML programs from programs/, run/stop them via the /execute_program action and follow the currently executing step with a live highlight.
